fields.description: Nine Collective is Wasl’s 215-home tower in Wasl 1, Al Kifaf, beside Zabeel Park. Its collection includes two- to four-bedroom apartments, three- and four-bedroom duplexes and five-bedroom duplex penthouses. Maid’s rooms and fitted kitchens are specified, with larger layouts offering distinct living and outdoor arrangements.
